final: WITH equipment_averages AS (SELECT equipref, AVG(humepct) AS avg_humidity FROM scanenvironment GROUP BY equipref HAVING COUNT(humepct) > 0), reference_averages AS (SELECT AVG(avg_humidity) AS all_equipment_avg FROM equipment_averages), kept AS (SELECT ea.equipref, ea.avg_humidity, ea.avg_humidity - ra.all_equipment_avg AS above_all_avg FROM equipment_averages ea CROSS JOIN reference_averages ra WHERE ea.avg_humidity > ra.all_equipment_avg), kept_mean AS (SELECT AVG(avg_humidity) AS kept_avg FROM kept) SELECT k.equipref, k.avg_humidity, k.above_all_avg, k.avg_humidity - km.kept_avg AS difference_from_kept_mean FROM kept k CROSS JOIN kept_mean km ORDER BY difference_from_kept_mean DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 10
